decisions.literal_text: Platform types приходят БЕЗ гарантированной nullability — ответственность на разработчике.
decisions.decision: TRUE in the stated platform-type scope. This says platform types lack guaranteed nullability and responsibility remains with the developer; it does not claim every Java type is a platform type. Recognized Java nullability annotations producing other Kotlin types do not falsify this field.

This names the learner misconception; it does not assert that Java types are safe. At most it is a weak/vague explanation of confusion, not a false factual claim.
